category_edits.rationale: Blend each current GRU state with its causal, valid-state recency-weighted mean: 90% current state and 10% pooled state, retaining the existing five-interaction half-life. At inference this gives the requested last-valid-state blend. Applies to all four category models; the generated predictor imports this same model class, preserving training/inference consistency without changing its writer.

response.change_summary: Replace pure recency pooling with a 90/10 GRU-state and recency-pool blend. Preserve histories, embeddings, GRU backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer, routing, and epoch settings.
